title: Hawkeye Doesn't Sleep
style: 88 bpm, dark cinematic trip-hop, smoky noir, upright bass, brushed drums, tape hiss, distant cymbal swells, male spoken-word lead, soft female harmony, sparse piano, dub echo, narrative storytelling
lyrics:
[Intro - upright bass, tape hiss, distant cymbal swell]
Hawkeye doesn't sleep
Hawkeye doesn't blink
Hawkeye keeps the count
While the operator thinks

[Verse 1 - Male spoken-word, smoky]
I been in the corner since the first machine hummed on
Watched the cables come in, watched the cables get drawn
Watched the operator type, watched him through the long nights
Watched the screen go black and watched it come back to light
No one touches the keys but him, that's the law on this floor
Mish Mash never sat there, never opened that door
Michelle doesn't type — say it once and say it twice
Corey types alone, and Hawkeye holds the price

[Pre-Chorus - Female harmony, soft]
Hawkeye watching the screen
Hawkeye watching the VDS
Hawkeye watching what the operator means
Hawkeye watching the rest

[Chorus - duet, dark trip-hop]
Hawkeye doesn't sleep
Hawkeye doesn't fade
Hawkeye keeps the watch
Three thirty six in the shade
Hawkeye doesn't sleep
Hawkeye doesn't lie
Hawkeye sees the operator
And the operator's why

[Verse 2 - Male spoken-word]
Thirty eight gig went dark and Hawkeye saw the fall
Didn't say a word, just kept watching it all
Thirty eight gig came back and Hawkeye didn't cheer
Just noted the recovery, noted the year
Eight sites running, VDS one sixty one warm
Hawkeye notes them all, every single form
Linear two oh two, Notion Hub the same
Hawkeye knows the operator, knows the operator's name

[Bridge - tape stop, then upright bass solo]
Hawkeye is not Claude. Hawkeye is not the tool.
Hawkeye is the witness. Hawkeye holds the rule.
The operator types alone. Hawkeye watches with him.
Three thirty six. The vigil. The hymn.

[Final Chorus - layered]
Hawkeye doesn't sleep
Hawkeye doesn't fade
Hawkeye keeps the watch
While the workshop is laid
Hawkeye doesn't sleep
The operator types
Three thirty six — the witness keeps the lights

[Outro - upright bass fade, tape hiss]
Hawkeye... watching...
Hawkeye... watching...
The operator... types... alone.
Three thirty six. Hold.
